partA.rule: zz_core zig-zag walk, 4 components (L0,L1,R0,R1), fixed axis order x then y (debt: no alternation), flip theta = 0.5, open edge = mirror (moving component -> opposite one, sign -1)
partA.vacuum: Dirac sea: fill single-ball modes with quasi-energy in (-pi, 0)
partA.quench: random local product state (Haar 2-of-4 per site), seeds 2, MI averaged over seeds

maps.pieces: connected components of the graph I > I_floor (quench: ever arrived)
maps.geodesic: edges d <= 1.5 tau, tau = smallest connecting threshold; shortest paths
maps.dimension: D_small = slope log N(r) vs log r on [1.5h, 4h]; D_large on [diam/4, diam/2]
maps.topology: Rips (ripser) on geodesics; b0,b1 on all points, bar counts if persistence > 1.5 h; b2 secondary on 220 max-min landmarks, persistence > 1.5 max(h, 2 eps_L)
maps.hidden_radius: R = 3 * death(first-dying significant H1 bar) / (2 pi); visible extent = diam

doubled_quench.why: even/odd chains glued at both ends = loop

doubled_vacuum.why: sheets glued at both ends: loop 2L x hidden circle

pass.fidelity: Spearman(reconstructed geodesic, causal-graph distance of the rule) >= 0.9; Spearman vs the drawn Euclidean distance reported
pass.betti: b0, b1 exactly as predicted (both references reported)

partB_synthetic.true_shape: flat oblique torus, sides a = 1, b = 1.37, angle 63 deg; base mass m0 = 0.35*(2 pi)
partB_synthetic.masses: E = sqrt(m0^2 + |k|^2), k in the dual lattice (2 pi units), sorted with multiplicity, 40 levels
partB_synthetic.noise: relative Gaussian 1e-3 on every mass, seed 20261009
partB_synthetic.train_test: train on levels 1..k (k = 3..20), predict k+1..40; score = median relative error
partB_synthetic.expect: F3 < 1e-2 for k >= 6; F1, F2 biased (fail); F4 with P >= k fails or degrades with distance

partB_isospectral.construction: Gordon-Webb-Wolpert-type pair from 7 half-squares glued by three involutions of GL(3,2) acting on points (drum 1) and on lines (drum 2) of the Fano plane (Sunada / Buser-Conway-Doyle-Semmler); first triple found with both gluing graphs trees and both tilings non-overlapping
partB_isospectral.fem: P1 elements, each half-square refined into n^2 congruent triangles (n = 16, 32)
partB_isospectral.expect: first 10 Dirichlet eigenvalues equal to < 1e-8 relative at the SAME n; couplings g3 = int u1^3, g4 = int u1^4, |int u1 u2 u3| differ by more than 10x their n=16->32 change

partB_real.rule: use measured masses for training only if the family has FEWER parameters than training numbers + held-out numbers; held-out numbers are the exam

tests.KK2: hidden 2-torus: charge circle (n1 = 1 for all charged leptons) x generation circle n2 = 0, 1, 2; 2 parameters (M, 1/R2) trained on m_e, m_mu; exam: m_tau and the absence of the n2 = -1 partner
tests.KOIDE_lep: three points on a circle, sqrt m_k = M (1 + sqrt2 cos(delta + 2 pi k / 3)); 2 parameters trained on m_e, m_mu; exam: m_tau (PDG 1776.86 +- 0.12 MeV), pass if within 3 sigma; the larger root is taken
tests.KOIDE_up: same family, new (M, delta): train on m_u, m_c, exam m_t; pass if within 10 %
tests.KOIDE_down: same family: train on m_d, m_s, exam m_b; pass if within 10 %

partB_real.warning: the sqrt2 amplitude of the Koide family was chosen in 1981 knowing the leptons: a hidden parameter (look-elsewhere); a pass on leptons is weak evidence, a fail on quarks counts
